guitar.guitaristsText: Mick Ronson / Carlos Alomar / Earl Slick
guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul (Ronson) / Fender Stratocaster / Telecaster
guitar.notes: Bowie used many different guitarists across eras with no single signature instrument tied to Bowie himself; medium is appropriate given Ronson's well-known Les Paul.

tone.target: clean jangly compression with bright rhythm edge
tone.profile: clean jangly compression with bright rhythm edge
tone.summary: A classic British clean tone setup using light compression, a Vox-style amp simulation (UK 50), Chorus for width, and a bright cab to achieve the jangly, compressed rhythm sound of 'Under Pressure'.
